name: Geumjidoen Supui Bam
source:
A visit to a new school where you apply as a teacher. But the school is in a suspicious forest, and someone on the way warns you about it….

“If you want to go back, you have to run before the moon rises.”

After arriving at the school as if someone leading you in, Realizes it’s not a normal school. Creepy eyes and shades welcoming you..?! It’s way too late to go back!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478140/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你应聘了一所新学校的教师，前去拜访。然而，学校坐落在一片诡异的森林里，途中还有人向你发出警告……

“如果想回去，就得在月亮升起之前逃走。”

你仿佛被某种力量引领着来到学校，这才意识到，这里并不是一所普通的学校。迎接你的，是令人毛骨悚然的目光与幽影……？！现在想回头，已经太迟了！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478140/]Steam[/url]]
